_why: Build-option conditionals inside OWNERS that exist only because z47 has a test harness. Upstream has no counterpart, so every branch makes the tested program differ from the shipped one. The count may FALL and may not rise; the endpoint is an empty object. Removing them means giving the harnesses the real types instead of harness-shaped ones. The count rose 59 -> 60 when a file-level LINK_SET exemption was removed: it exempted src/core/numeric/command_wrappers.zig with a reason about which owner files a lane links, and that file's only build_options site is an EXPORT decision. The rise is the gate seeing a site it had been hiding, not a new seam.
